scope: All primary-instrument A/B/C splits with zero buffer, all3 states/pollutants and10 repeats. Instrument/buffer sensitivities remain in the primary exact/separable study; they are not rerun for this richer family.
model: Sum of two Matérn32 kernels with distinct scalar scales and full positive-definite3x3 coregionalization matrices. Each component uses output variances and valid partial correlations; component labels are interchangeable, and no unique component-loading interpretation is claimed.
fairness: Each component variance constrained to half the primary separable output-variance bounds, giving the same total diagonal range. Target-only two-kernel mixture has these same component bounds. Noise/scale bounds and float64 optimizer tolerances match the primary study. Four complete training-only starts per fit.
mean: Same training-only centering/scaling and zero-centered working mean as the primary comparison. No outer test outcomes enter any fitted parameter.
fallback: Failed mixture predictions use primary separate fit; failed LMC uses mixture-independent predictions. Preserve all starts, bounds and failures.
comparison: Compare richer borrowing against its own mixture-independent baseline as well as the primary single-kernel independent fit. Improvement due to marginal flexibility is not assigned automatically to borrowing.
